content: [![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LieOnLion/LieOnLion/main/images/badges/a-los-creation.svg)](https://modrinth.com/organization/lieonstudios) [![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pnk2u/resources/main/ModProjects/More-Stick-Variants/badge/requires-mstv.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-stick-variants) 社區： [![discord](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LieOnLion/LieOnLion/main/images/badges/buttons/discord.svg)](https://discord.lieonlion.dev/) 源碼： [![github](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LieOnLion/LieOnLion/main/images/badges/buttons/github.svg)](https://github.com/pnk2u/More-Tool-Variants) pnku： [![pnku.de](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pnk2u/resources/main/ModProjects/shared/pres/icon/pnku_de_logo.svg)](https://www.pnku.de) [![modrinth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LieOnLion/LieOnLion/main/images/badges/buttons/modrinth.svg)](https://modrinth.com/user/pnku) [![curseforge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LieOnLion/LieOnLion/main/images/badges/buttons/curseforge.svg)](https://www.curseforge.com/members/pnku/) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pnk2u/resources/main/ModProjects/shared/pres/desc_hr_top.svg) ## 更多工具變體 使用橡木工具變得無聊了？你覺得其他樹木也值得一些關注嗎？ ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pnk2u/resources/main/ModProjects/More-Tool-Variants/pres/mr_desc_banner.png) 新添加工具的一覽，使用了 [roundaround](https://modrinth.com/user/Roundaround) 的 '[更多盔甲架變體](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-armor-stand-variants/)' 和 '[盔甲架](https://modrinth.com/mod/armor-stands)'（用於佈置）。 ### 為 Minecraft 添加了 101 種新的 _鏟子_、101 種新的 _鎬子_、101 種新的 _斧頭_、101 種新的 _鋤頭_ 和 11 種新的 _刷子_。 ###  [![](https://uwu.catgirl.host/i/v1115.png) 蒼白橡木與 ![](https://uwu.catgirl.host/i/gku5m.png) 銅材質由 **_hunnycakehorse_** 製作](https://modrinth.com/user/hunnycakehorse) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pnk2u/resources/main/ModProjects/shared/pres/desc_hr_bottom.svg) [**![](https://uwu.catgirl.host/i/syat4.gif)**]()
